quote: Fear is a tool. Used properly, it can save your life. Used improperly, it will end it.
A wise man once told me that the only way to survive is to never let them see you bleed.
The most important thing is to survive. Everything else is negotiable.
I don't make the same mistake twice. I make it five or six times, just to be sure.
The dead don't need justice. The living do.
A good lie is built on a foundation of truth.
I don't fear death. I fear becoming irrelevant before it.
Chaos is just order waiting to be understood.
episodeTitle: And the Thrill of the Chase

quote: There's no version of this life where everyone I love stays safe. I chose anyway.
I don't believe in closure. I believe in managing what's left open.
